name: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32C6
notes: Native USB (USB Serial/JTAG on GPIO12/13), so D6/D7 (UART0, GPIO16/17) are free for a sensor; the ROM prints a boot message on D6 at power-up. Only UART1 is free, so a UART sensor must use uart 1. Drawn from the component side with the USB-C port at the bottom, which is upside down compared to Seeed's pinout picture (USB at the top there): D0 is at the bottom right and 5V at the bottom left. Pins are labelled D0-D10 on the board. The antenna is chosen by an RF switch: GPIO3 low powers it and GPIO14 low selects the built-in ceramic antenna (high = U.FL connector), so the firmware drives both low at boot. The yellow user LED on GPIO15 is active low (3V3 - 1.5k - LED - GPIO15). D0-D2 (GPIO0-2) are LP GPIOs. None of the header pins is a strapping pin.
